scenes.heading: Building a portfolio with zero brand deals yet

sents.d: Building a portfolio with zero brand deals yet
Spec content — made without a paid brief — is how almost every UGC creator starts.
Nearly every UGC creator's first portfolio pieces are 'spec' content: videos made for a real or imagined product without being paid, purely to demonstrate skill and style to future clients.

Pick 3-5 products you already own and genuinely like, and create the kind of content a brand would actually use — a demo, a problem/solution story, an unboxing reaction — rather than a generic testimonial with no real product moment.
Organize these into a simple portfolio (a link-in-bio page or a short reel) grouped by content type, so a brand scanning quickly can immediately see the style of work you do.

take: Make 3–5 spec videos of products you own to build a portfolio.
